FloPlast round downpipe clips are an essential uPVC drainage component designed for securely fixing 68mm diameter rainwater downpipes. These durable white pipe clips offer a practical, easy to install solution, perfect for both new build construction and refurbishment projects across various properties. Compatible with most major manufacturers' 68mm round downpipe systems, these FloPlast clips ensure reliable support for external drainage, enhancing the longevity of rainwater management setups.
